question: Where is the breath-filling vital air said to be situated?
premises: The vital air fills with breath
The vital air is situated somewhere
Its locus is all living beings
inference: The breath-filling vital air is situated in all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement of saṃsthitam with vāyuḥ is syntactically unusual.
plain_english: The breath-filling vital air is situated in all living beings.
